sam: canary promote payments-ui v3.4.1 stalled in ap-southeast. Pods ImagePullBackOff, deploy-bot reports digest mismatch across registries.

deploy-bot: [PROMOTE] release=payments-ui chart=payments-ui version=3.4.1 region=ap-southeast event=pod_pull_failed expected=sha256:5f6a1c actual=sha256:7b8d2e error=BlobUnknown

liz: likely mirror lag. proposal: pause further regional promotions to ap-southeast, apply a quick helm patch to pin image.digest to last-known-good sha to keep service healthy, and add a blurb to release notes.

registry-bot: mirror-status mirror-payments-ui last_attempt=2026-03-23T14:02:10Z synced=410/410 integrity=pass

sam: I've added a temporary deploy exclusion for ap-southeast for this release. Quick pin command: `helm upgrade payments-ui ./charts/payments-ui --namespace payments --set image.digest=sha256:7b8d2e --reuse-values`

liz: rollback snippets if needed: `helm rollback payments-ui 2 --namespace payments` or `kubectl -n payments set image deploy/payments-ui payments-ui=registry.redwood/payments-ui:3.4.0@sha256:7b8d2e`

sam: will re-run promotion after registry parity verified; owner assigned to liz. Release notes: "APAC promotion delayed due to transient registry mirror; temporary pin applied to maintain availability."

deploy-bot: promotion paused until manual resume.
